title: Terms of Service
intro: Welcome to Bill Please. These Terms of Service ("Terms") govern your use of the Bill Please web application (the "Service"). By accessing or using the Service, you agree to be bound by these Terms. If you do not agree, please do not use the Service.

sections.heading: 1. About the Service
body: Bill Please is a free, mobile-first web application that helps groups split restaurant bills and shared expenses. The Service runs in your web browser and does not require an account.
The Service is provided for personal, non-commercial use as a convenience tool for calculating how a bill may be divided.

sections.heading: 2. Local Data Storage
body: Bill Please does not send your bill data to us. Everything you enter, including bill titles, items, payers, currency settings, and payment details, is stored locally in your browser (via localStorage) on your own device. The optional receipt scanning feature is the only part of the Service that sends data to our server, as described in Section 4 and in the Privacy Policy.

Because your data is stored only on your device, clearing your browser data or using a different device or browser will remove or fail to display previously entered information. You are responsible for your own data.

sections.heading: 3. Your Responsibilities
body: You are responsible for the accuracy of the information you enter and for verifying any amounts the Service calculates before relying on them.

All calculations, including bill splits, service charge, VAT, currency conversion, and totals, are provided for convenience only and may contain rounding differences or errors. You should independently confirm final amounts.
You agree to use the Service lawfully and not to misuse it or interfere with its operation.

sections.heading: 4. Receipt Scanning
body: The Service can read items from a photo of a receipt that you choose. The photo is sent to our receipt scanning server, processed, and not kept after the scan, as described in the Privacy Policy.

Items are read automatically and may be wrong or missing, including names, quantities, prices, service charge, VAT, and discounts. Check every item before you import it and before you rely on the totals.

Only scan receipts you have the right to use. Do not use the feature to upload anything other than receipts, or to send automated or excessive requests. We may limit, suspend, or stop the feature at any time, for example when the server is busy or unavailable.

sections.heading: 5. Payments, PromptPay and Bank Accounts
body: The Service can generate a Thai PromptPay QR code from a phone number or national ID that you provide, and can show a Thai bank account number that you enter, to make settling a shared bill more convenient.

Bill Please does not process, hold, or transfer any money and is not a payment service or financial institution. Any payment is made directly between you and the relevant parties through your own banking or payment applications. We are not responsible for any payment, transfer, or the accuracy of any QR code, bank account number, or recipient details. Check the recipient's name in your banking app before you confirm a transfer.

sections.heading: 6. Analytics and Third-Party Services
body: The Service may use third-party services, such as Google Analytics, to collect anonymous, aggregated usage statistics that help us improve the Service, and Cloudflare Turnstile to protect the receipt scanning feature from automated abuse. These services may process limited technical information in accordance with their own terms and privacy policies.
The Service is distributed and its source code is hosted through third-party platforms. Your use of those platforms is subject to their respective terms.

body: The Service, including its name, design, and source code (except third-party components under their own licenses), is owned by the developer of Bill Please. You may not copy, modify, or redistribute the Service except as permitted by its applicable open-source license or by law.

sections.heading: 8. Disclaimer of Warranties

We do not warrant that the Service will be uninterrupted, error-free, or available at all times.

sections.heading: 9. Limitation of Liability
body: To the maximum extent permitted by law, the developer of Bill Please shall not be liable for any indirect, incidental, or consequential damages, or for any loss arising from incorrect calculations, incorrectly scanned receipts, lost data, payment disputes, or your use of or inability to use the Service.

sections.heading: 10. Changes to the Service and Terms
body: We may update, change, or discontinue the Service or these Terms at any time. Changes become effective when the updated Terms are posted within the Service. Your continued use of the Service after changes are posted constitutes acceptance of the revised Terms.

sections.heading: 12. Contact
body: If you have any questions about these Terms, please contact us at contact@chatree.dev.
